title: Neck Manipulation Safety — Screening for Artery Problems Before You Treat

hook.en: Neck pain can be the first sign of an artery tear. Learn the screen that protects your patient before you mobilise or manipulate.
hook.ur: Gardan ka dard artery tear ki pehli nishani ho sakta hai. Mobilise ya manipulate karne se pehle woh screen seekhein jo patient ko mehfooz rakhti hai.

goal.en: By the end, you'll screen a neck patient for artery problems with clinical reasoning, know why the old "pre-manipulation tests" fail, and act correctly if you suspect one.
goal.ur: End tak aap gardan ke patient mein clinical reasoning se artery ke masle ki screening karenge, jaan jayenge ke purane "pre-manipulation tests" kyun nakaam hain, aur shak hone par sahi qadam uthayenge.

text.en: Serious harm from neck treatment is **rare**, but it is the harm you must never cause. The arteries in the neck (the **vertebral** and **carotid** arteries) can tear, a problem called **cervical arterial dysfunction**. Its early symptom is often **neck pain or headache**, so a patient can walk into your clinic with a dissection that has already started. Your job is not to cause it and not to miss it.
text.ur: Gardan ke ilaaj se serious nuksan **kam** hota hai, lekin yeh woh nuksan hai jo aap ko kabhi nahi karna. Gardan ki arteries (**vertebral** aur **carotid**) phat sakti hain, jise **cervical arterial dysfunction** kehte hain. Iski shuruaati alamat aksar **gardan ka dard ya sar dard** hoti hai, is liye patient aisi dissection ke saath clinic aa sakta hai jo pehle se shuru ho chuki ho. Aap ka kaam hai na iska sabab banna aur na ise miss karna.

text.en: Think of the artery wall like the layers of a garden hose. If the inner layer splits, blood can push between the layers and a clot can form. A sudden turn or a trivial knock can start the split, and the first thing you feel is a pulling pain in the neck. The hose looks normal from outside, so you cannot see it: you have to ask the right questions.
text.ur: Artery ki deewar ko garden hose ki tahon ki tarah samjhein. Andar ki tah phat jaye to khoon tahon ke beech ghus sakta hai aur clot ban sakta hai. Achanak mudna ya halki si chot phat shuru kar sakti hai, aur pehli cheez gardan mein kheenchne wala dard hota hai. Hose bahar se theek lagta hai, is liye aap ko sahi sawal poochne parte hain.

title.en: A safe neck screen in four steps
title.ur: Gardan ki mehfooz screening chaar qadam mein

steps.title: Ask about the pain
steps.detail: Is this pain new and unlike any neck or head pain the patient has had? Sudden, severe, "worst ever", or a pulling pain at the side of the neck or back of the head is a warning. || Dard ke baare mein poochhein

steps.title: Ask about risks and recent events
steps.detail: Recent neck trauma (even minor), a recent infection, high blood pressure, migraine-type headaches, smoking, high cholesterol, family history of vascular disease or a connective tissue disease. || Risk aur haal ke waqiat poochhein

steps.title: Ask about symptoms and examine
steps.detail: The 5 Ds and 3 Ns: dizziness, diplopia, dysarthria, dysphagia, drop attacks; nausea, numbness, nystagmus. Check blood pressure and the cranial nerves, and look for a drooping eyelid or a small pupil on one side. || Alamat poochhein aur examine karein

steps.title: Decide: treat, change the plan, or refer
steps.detail: If anything points to an artery problem, do not manipulate or mobilise the neck; arrange urgent medical care. If it is clear, explain the risk, gain consent and choose the lowest-risk effective technique. || Faisla karein: treat, plan badlein ya refer

question.en: A patient has sudden "worst ever" neck pain after a fall, with a headache and a droopy eyelid. What do you do?
question.ur: Ek patient ko gir kar achanak "ab tak ka sabse bura" gardan ka dard hai, saath sar dard aur ek palak neeche. Aap kya karenge?

text.en: Do a gentle manipulation to relieve the pain
text.ur: Dard door karne ke liye halki manipulation

feedback.ur: Manipulation dissection ko bigaar sakti hai.

text.en: Reassure and book a follow-up in a week
text.ur: Tasalli dein aur ek hafte baad dobara bulayein

feedback.ur: Yeh alamat intezar nahi kar sakti.

text.en: Do not treat the neck and arrange emergency medical care
text.ur: Gardan ka ilaaj na karein aur emergency medical care ka intezam karein

feedback.en: Yes — pain like this with a droopy eyelid (Horner's) suggests an artery dissection, which is an emergency.
feedback.ur: Haan — aise dard ke saath palak girna (Horner's) artery dissection ka ishara hai, jo emergency hai.

title.en: The old tests and what the evidence says
title.ur: Purane tests aur saboot kya kehta hai

rows.en: Sustained end-range rotation or extension ("VBI tests")
rows.ur: Aakhri range par rotation ya extension rokna ("VBI tests")

rows.en: Tries to provoke symptoms from the vertebral artery
rows.ur: Vertebral artery se alamat paida karne ki koshish

rows.en: Poor accuracy, can miss a dissection and can provoke harm; not recommended alone
rows.ur: Kam accuracy, dissection miss kar sakta hai aur nuksan pohancha sakta hai; akele sifarish nahi

rows.en: Clinical reasoning (history, risks, symptoms, blood pressure, cranial nerves)
rows.ur: Clinical reasoning (history, risks, alamat, blood pressure, cranial nerves)

rows.en: Builds the whole picture of vascular risk
rows.ur: Vascular risk ki poori tasveer banata hai

rows.en: Informed consent with the options and risks
rows.ur: Options aur risks ke saath informed consent

rows.en: Lets the patient choose with full information
rows.ur: Patient poori maloomat ke saath chunta hai

rows.en: Expected in practice and protects both sides
rows.ur: Practice mein zaroori aur dono taraf ko mehfooz rakhta hai

text.en: **5 Ds and 3 Ns**: Dizziness, Diplopia, Dysarthria, Dysphagia, Drop attacks; Nausea, Numbness, Nystagmus. Any of these with a new neck or head pain is a stop sign.
text.ur: **5 Ds aur 3 Ns**: Dizziness, Diplopia, Dysarthria, Dysphagia, Drop attacks; Nausea, Numbness, Nystagmus. Naye gardan ya sar dard ke saath inmein se koi bhi stop sign hai.

text.en: **Trusting a negative positional test.** A patient who "passes" a neck-rotation test is not proven safe, because the test misses most dissections. Using it to feel safe makes you stop asking the questions that matter.
text.ur: **Negative positional test par bharosa.** Jo patient gardan rotation test "pass" kar le woh mehfooz sabit nahi hota, kyunke test zyada tar dissections miss kar deta hai. Isse mehfooz mehsoos karna aap ko zaroori sawal poochne se rok deta hai.

question.en: Why is a negative neck-rotation positional test not enough?
question.ur: Negative neck-rotation positional test kaafi kyun nahi?

text.en: It has poor accuracy and misses most artery problems
text.ur: Iski accuracy kam hai aur yeh zyada tar artery ke masle miss kar deta hai

feedback.en: Right — a negative result does not make the neck safe, so the history and examination carry the decision.
feedback.ur: Theek — negative result se gardan mehfooz nahi hoti, is liye history aur examination faisla karte hain.

feedback.en: Time is not the problem; accuracy is.
feedback.ur: Masla waqt ka nahi, accuracy ka hai.

text.en: Because it only tests the carotid artery
text.ur: Kyunke yeh sirf carotid artery test karta hai

feedback.ur: Yeh kisi artery ko bharosay se test nahi karta.

question.en: Which finding means you stop and arrange medical care today?
question.ur: Kaun si finding ka matlab hai ke aap ruk jayein aur aaj hi medical care ka intezam karein?

text.en: New severe neck pain with double vision and slurred speech
text.ur: Naya shadeed gardan ka dard double vision aur zubaan larkharane ke saath

feedback.en: Yes — these are warning symptoms of an artery problem or a stroke and need emergency care.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh artery ke masle ya stroke ki warning alamat hain aur emergency care chahti hain.

text.en: A click when turning the head, without pain
text.ur: Sar mode to click, bina dard ke

feedback.en: A painless click is common and not a warning on its own.
feedback.ur: Bina dard ki click aam hai aur akeli warning nahi.

text.en: Mild neck stiffness after a long drive that eases with movement
text.ur: Lambay safar ke baad halki gardan ki akarhan jo harkat se kam ho

feedback.en: This is a common mechanical pattern, not a warning.
feedback.ur: Yeh aam mechanical pattern hai, warning nahi.

text.en: **Choose the lowest-risk effective option.** Many neck patients improve with exercise, education and gentle mobilisation. If you use a thrust, document the screening you did, the consent you took and the response afterwards. **Re-screen at every visit** — symptoms can change.
text.ur: **Kam se kam risk wali asardaar option chunein.** Bohat se gardan ke patients exercise, education aur halki mobilisation se behtar hote hain. Agar thrust istemal karein to screening, consent aur baad ka response document karein. **Har visit par dobara screen karein** — alamat badal sakti hain.

question.en: A patient says the neck pain started a week after a minor sports collision and now comes with a pulsing noise in the ear. Why does it matter?
question.ur: Patient kehta hai gardan ka dard ek halki sports collision ke ek hafte baad shuru hua aur ab kaan mein dhadakne ki awaz aati hai. Yeh kyun ahem hai?

answer.en: Because new neck pain after minor trauma with a pulsing noise in the ear is a recognised vascular warning: an artery in the neck may be injured and blood flow is changing. Do not treat the neck; the patient needs prompt medical assessment.
answer.ur: Kyunke halki chot ke baad naya gardan ka dard aur kaan mein dhadakne ki awaz ek jaani pehchani vascular warning hai: gardan ki artery zakhmi ho sakti hai aur khoon ka behao badal raha hai. Gardan ka ilaaj na karein; patient ko jaldi medical assessment chahiye.

beats.patient: A 44-year-old woman has had a new, severe pain at the back of the head and neck for three days after a car-park reversing jolt. She feels light-headed and her left eyelid droops a little.
beats.assessment: She has a new unfamiliar pain, a recent minor trauma and a drooping eyelid (Horner's sign); blood pressure is high.
beats.treatment: Do not treat the neck. Explain calmly that this needs a doctor today, arrange emergency care and document the findings.
beats.reassess: The emergency team confirms a dissection and treats it; you review once she is medically cleared.

text.en: **Never manipulate the neck when a vascular cause is possible.** Sudden severe neck pain or headache with dizziness, double vision, slurred speech, trouble swallowing, facial numbness, a droopy eyelid, or any new neurological sign needs **emergency medical care now** — call an ambulance, keep the patient lying down and do not let them drive.
text.ur: **Jab artery ka masla mumkin ho to gardan ko kabhi manipulate na karein.** Achanak shadeed gardan ka dard ya sar dard, saath chakkar, double vision, zubaan larkharana, nigalne mein dushwari, chehre ka sunn hona, palak girna ya koi bhi naya neurological sign **abhi emergency medical care** chahta hai — ambulance bulayein, patient ko letaye rakhein aur gaari na chalane dein.

summary.en: Neck pain can be the first sign of an artery tear, so every neck patient needs a vascular screen: pain, risks, symptoms, blood pressure and cranial nerves.
summary.ur: Gardan ka dard artery tear ki pehli nishani ho sakta hai, is liye har gardan ke patient ko vascular screen chahiye: dard, risks, alamat, blood pressure aur cranial nerves.

summary.en: The old positional "pre-manipulation tests" are not accurate enough to prove a neck safe; clinical reasoning replaces them.
summary.ur: Purane positional "pre-manipulation tests" gardan ko mehfooz sabit karne ke liye kaafi durust nahi; unki jagah clinical reasoning aati hai.

summary.en: If a vascular cause is possible, do not treat the neck: arrange emergency care. If it is clear, take informed consent and use the lowest-risk effective technique.
summary.ur: Agar vascular wajah mumkin ho to gardan ka ilaaj na karein: emergency care ka intezam karein. Agar saaf ho to informed consent lein aur kam se kam risk wali asardaar technique istemal karein.

back.en: A problem of the vertebral or carotid arteries in the neck, such as a dissection, which can present as neck pain or headache.
back.ur: Gardan ki vertebral ya carotid arteries ka masla, maslan dissection, jo gardan ke dard ya sar dard ki tarah aa sakta hai.

front.en: What are the 5 Ds and 3 Ns?

back.en: Dizziness, diplopia, dysarthria, dysphagia, drop attacks; nausea, numbness, nystagmus.
back.ur: Dizziness, diplopia, dysarthria, dysphagia, drop attacks; nausea, numbness, nystagmus.

front.en: Can a negative neck-rotation test clear the neck?
front.ur: Kya negative neck-rotation test gardan ko clear kar sakta hai?

back.en: No. These positional tests are not accurate enough; clinical reasoning decides.
back.ur: Nahi. Yeh positional tests kaafi durust nahi; faisla clinical reasoning karti hai.

front.en: What do you do if you suspect an artery dissection?
front.ur: Artery dissection ka shak ho to kya karein?

back.en: Do not treat the neck; arrange emergency medical care and keep the patient safe.
back.ur: Gardan ka ilaaj na karein; emergency medical care ka intezam karein aur patient ko mehfooz rakhein.

note.en: The wider list of reasons to stop and refer.
note.ur: Ruk kar refer karne ki wajoohat ki bari list.

note.en: Why a test that misses cases cannot make a neck safe.
note.ur: Jo test cases miss kare woh gardan ko mehfooz nahi kar sakta, kyun.
